title: Anti-DDI v3.0.1: an evidence framework and benchmark resource for drug non-interaction
description: Anti-DDI v3.0.1 contains 797 audited drug-pair evidence records, including 538 T1/T2 higher-support research benchmark candidates, a reproducible ATC5 degree/popularity-bias diagnostic, structured clinical/regulatory exclusions, and eight targeted human clinical-pharmacology anchors. A previously documented four-arm RIDI/classifier experiment is withdrawn as validation evidence after a public adversarial-audit correction. The resource is for research and benchmarking, not prescribing.
